answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 35809 Country: India Title: Can we read Urdu translation of the holy Quran by Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari? Is he from Ulama-e-Haq? Question: Can we read Urdu translation of the holy Quran by Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari? Is he from Ulama-e-Haq? Answer ID: 35809 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 229/229/M=1433) Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari was among Ulama-e-Haq. You can read his Quran translation. However, if you find any complication you should consult any authentic aalim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
